ahead.saint: Word of you got here first. People nod as you pass, and somebody's already putting the kettle on.
ahead.good: They've heard of you here. Mostly good things.
ahead.waver: They've heard your name here. Nobody seems sure what to make of it.
ahead.fallen: They've heard of you here. Conversations stop when you walk past.
ahead.wicked: Doors close as you walk in. They've heard of you, even here.

confession.title: Confession
confession.open: The cleric draws a curtain across the window and sits down with you. 'Say what you came to say. It stays between you, me and the gods.'
confession.none: 'You've nothing on you the Watch would hang you for. Go home. Sleep.'
confession.today: 'Once a day. Even the gods need a rest from some of us.'
after: The cleric listens without looking at you, and is quiet for a long time after.
'It doesn't wash off. But it weighs less, carried in the open. If the Watch ever asks, I'll say you came to me first.'
confession.villagers: I killed people. Villagers. ({n} of them.)
confession.stores: I broke into people's stores and took what they'd saved.
confession.hand: I collected for the Gilded Hand.
confession.shrines: I prayed at the cult's shrines, and something answered.
confession.converted: I brought people to the Chariot's faith. ({n} of them.) They don't know their own names now.
confession.cult: I did the cult's work. Their scroll, their quotas. I ticked them off like chores.
confession.dealing: I sold the valley poison. Hand to hand, for emeralds. ({n} times.)
confession.resisted: When the Watch came for me, I fought them. I won. I'm not sure that was winning.

bounty.need_rank: The Gilded Hand doesn't take contracts from people it doesn't know. (You need a Hand rank.)
bounty.need_money: The Hand's price is 20 emeralds, in your hands. You don't have them.
bounty.protected: The Hand's agent shakes his head. '{name} is one of ours, higher than you. Try that again and the price will be on you.'
bounty.cooldown: There's already a price on {name}'s head. The Hand doesn't take the same job twice in three days.
bounty.placed: Twenty emeralds change hands. 'Consider it done,' the Hand's agent says. 'Night falls, they come.'
bounty.warned: Someone has paid the Gilded Hand for your head. They'll come after dark.
bounty.title: A Price on {name}'s Head
bounty.text: The Gilded Hand will send its hunters after {name} the next night they're out under the sky. 20 emeralds, from your inventory. You'll need a Hand rank, and they'll refuse if {name} is higher in the Hand than you.

testify.title: The Watch Has Taken {name}
testify.text: A Watch runner finds you. '{name} is on trial tonight. You were there on day {day}, when they {what}. The court would hear you, if you'll speak.'

what.conversion: turned a villager to the cult's faith

testify.late: 'Too late. The court's already given its verdict.'
testify.thanks_against: 'The court thanks you.' The runner writes your name down.
testify.thanks_for: 'The court will hear it.' The runner doesn't look convinced.
